# Original Living Alphabet Characters

A-Z SVG letter characters for reading and phonics. The letter glyph itself is the body: soft rounded shape, eyes, mouth, small arms/feet, and per-letter colors. Runtime interaction states are handled by `AlphabetCharacter.vue`.

These assets are original to this app and are meant to capture the general feel of friendly living letters without copying any third-party artwork.

- Individual assets: `a.svg` through `z.svg`
- Overview sheet: `alphabet-characters.svg`
- Runtime component: `client/src/components/AlphabetCharacter.vue`
